book_title: Around and About Paris (Volume III): New Horizons — Haussmann's Annexation — The 13th-20th Arrondissements
author: Thirza Vallois
source_file: Around and about Paris (Vallois, Thirza) 13 to 20 arrondisment.pdf

chunks.summary: Opening essay on the 13th arrondissement — Chinatown's emergence, industrial heritage along the Bièvre, the Gobelins workshops, BnF Tolbiac.

chunks.section_title: 13th Arr: Place d'Italie to Cité Florale
chunks.summary: Walk from Place d'Italie through Butte-aux-Cailles to Cité Florale — old tanneries, working-class housing, rural remnants.
Combined short sections: Chinatown (Avenues d'Ivry and Choisy) and the historic Salpêtrière hospital.
Opening essay on the 14th arrondissement — Montparnasse bohemia, the catacombs, Denfert-Rochereau.

chunks.section_title: 14th Arr: Carrefour Vavin to Rue Daguerre
chunks.summary: Walk from Place Pablo-Picasso (Carrefour Vavin) through the old artist quarter to the rue Daguerre market.
Walk from Place Denfert-Rochereau northward through the Observatoire quarter.
Short walk from Place Ferdinand-Brunot to the Parc de Montsouris.
Opening essay on the 15th arrondissement — Grenelle, Vaugirard, Front de Seine.
Walk from Montparnasse to La Ruche artist colony — through the 15th's residential and industrial heritage.
Opening essay on the 16th arrondissement — bourgeois Paris, Bois de Boulogne, Passy, Auteuil.
Walk through the old village of Auteuil — rue d'Auteuil, market on Place Jean-Lorrain, villas.
Walk from Passy to Chaillot in the northern 16th — Maison de Balzac, Palais de Chaillot approach.
Opening essay on the 17th arrondissement — Ternes, Monceau, Batignolles.

chunks.section_title: 17th Arr: Place des Ternes to Boulevard Berthier
chunks.summary: Walk from Place des Ternes to Boulevard Berthier — rue Poncelet market, Avenue de Wagram.
Walk through La Plaine Monceau — the grand bourgeois quarter around Parc Monceau.
Walk through Epinettes and Batignolles — the quiet village-like northern edge of the 17th.
Opening essay on the 18th arrondissement — Montmartre's religious and bohemian history, Pigalle, La Goutte-d'Or.
Extended walk through Montmartre — Place du Tertre, Sacré-Coeur, Moulin Rouge, artist studios, the Butte.
Walk through La Goutte-d'Or — immigrant Paris, North African and Sub-Saharan African quarter, rue des Poissonniers market.
Opening essay on the 19th arrondissement — La Villette's slaughterhouse past, the canals, working-class Paris.
Walk from Belleville to Pré-Saint-Gervais — the 19th's hillside village heritage.
Walk around Parc des Buttes-Chaumont — Haussmann's dramatic landscaped park built on a former quarry.
Walk through La Villette — Parc de la Villette, the Cité des Sciences, the old slaughterhouses.
Opening essay on the 20th arrondissement — Belleville, Ménilmontant, Charonne, Père-Lachaise.

chunks.section_title: 20th Arr: Bagnolet through Charonne to Père-Lachaise
chunks.summary: Walk from Place de la Porte de Bagnolet through old Charonne village to the Père-Lachaise cemetery.
Walk through Belleville and Ménilmontant — Edith Piaf and Maurice Chevalier's birthplaces, immigrant Paris, Parc de Belleville.
Closing essay on the Seine and Paris's river-centred identity — ports, bridges, bateaux-mouches, Île aux Cygnes.
